requirements.quote:
If a server receives a packet that indicates an unsupported version
   and if the packet is large enough to initiate a new connection for
   any supported version, the server SHOULD send a Version Negotiation
   packet as described in Section 6.1.  A server MAY limit the number of
   packets to which it responds with a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.condition: A server receives a packet indicating an unsupported version, and the packet is large enough to initiate a new connection for any supported version.
requirements.required_behavior: The server should send a Version Negotiation packet as described in Section 6.1.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver a sufficiently large packet carrying an unsupported version and observe whether the server emits the specified packet type.

requirements.quote:
packet as described in Section 6.1.  A server MAY limit the number of
   packets to which it responds with a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.condition: The server receives packets to which it could respond with Version Negotiation packets.
requirements.required_behavior: The server may impose a limit on the number of packets that receive Version Negotiation responses.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation can be inspected or tested for a response-count limiting policy.

requirements.quote: Servers MUST drop smaller packets that specify unsupported versions.
requirements.condition: A server receives a smaller packet that specifies an unsupported version.
requirements.required_behavior: The server must drop the packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The server must not process or respond to the packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can send an undersized packet specifying an unsupported version and verify that it is dropped without a response or further processing.

requirements.condition: A server receives a sufficiently long datagram using a version that the server does not support.
requirements.required_behavior: The server should respond with a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can send a sufficiently long datagram for an unsupported version and observe the response packet type.

requirements.quote:
Packets with a supported version, or no Version field, are matched to
   a connection using the connection ID or -- for packets with zero-
   length connection IDs -- the local address and port.  These packets
   are processed using the selected connection; otherwise, the server
   continues as described below.
requirements.condition: A packet has a supported version or has no Version field, and its connection ID is nonzero-length.
requirements.required_behavior: The server matches the packet to a connection using the connection ID and processes it using the selected connection when a match is found.
requirements.why_checkable: Connection-selection instrumentation or tests can verify that nonzero-length connection IDs are used as the matching key and that matched packets use the selected connection.

requirements.quote:
Packets with a supported version, or no Version field, are matched to
   a connection using the connection ID or -- for packets with zero-
   length connection IDs -- the local address and port.  These packets
   are processed using the selected connection; otherwise, the server
   continues as described below.
requirements.condition: A packet has a supported version or has no Version field, and it has a zero-length connection ID.
requirements.required_behavior: The server matches the packet to a connection using the local address and port and processes it using the selected connection when a match is found.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can send zero-length-connection-ID packets over controlled local address and port tuples and verify connection selection and processing.

requirements.quote:
Packets with a supported version, or no Version field, are matched to
   a connection using the connection ID or -- for packets with zero-
   length connection IDs -- the local address and port.  These packets
   are processed using the selected connection; otherwise, the server
   continues as described below.
requirements.condition: A packet with a supported version or no Version field cannot be matched to a connection by the applicable matching key.
requirements.required_behavior: The server continues with the subsequent server packet handling rules in this section.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The server must not process the packet using a nonexistent selected connection.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can submit an unmatched packet and verify that handling follows the new-connection or fallback paths below rather than established-connection processing.

requirements.quote:
If the packet is an Initial packet fully conforming with the
   specification, the server proceeds with the handshake (Section 7).
   This commits the server to the version that the client selected.
requirements.condition: The server receives an Initial packet that fully conforms with the specification.
requirements.required_behavior: The server proceeds with the handshake and commits to the version selected by the client.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: After proceeding with the handshake, the server must not use a different protocol version for that connection.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can send a conforming Initial packet and verify both handshake progression and the connection's selected-version state.

requirements.quote:
If a server refuses to accept a new connection, it SHOULD send an
   Initial packet containing a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with error code
   CONNECTION_REFUSED.
requirements.condition: A server refuses to accept a new connection.
requirements.error_behavior: The server should send an Initial packet containing a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame whose error code is CONNECTION_REFUSED.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can induce refusal of a new connection and validate the response packet type, frame type, and error code.

requirements.quote:
If the packet is a 0-RTT packet, the server MAY buffer a limited
   number of these packets in anticipation of a late-arriving Initial
   packet.
requirements.condition: The server receives a 0-RTT packet before a late-arriving Initial packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The server may buffer only a limited number of such 0-RTT packets while anticipating the Initial packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: If the server buffers these packets, it must not buffer an unlimited number of them.
requirements.why_checkable: A stress test or configuration inspection can determine whether pre-Initial 0-RTT buffering is bounded.

requirements.quote:
packet.  Clients are not able to send Handshake packets prior to
   receiving a server response, so servers SHOULD ignore any such
   packets.
requirements.condition: A server receives a Handshake packet before the client could have received a server response.
requirements.required_behavior: The server should ignore the Handshake packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The server should not process the packet as a valid Handshake packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can send a Handshake packet before any server response and verify that it causes no handshake processing or state transition.

requirements.quote: Servers MUST drop incoming packets under all other circumstances.
requirements.condition: An incoming packet falls under none of the preceding handling circumstances.
requirements.required_behavior: The server must drop the packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The server must not process or respond to the packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can construct packets outside every preceding accepted or specially handled case and verify that each is discarded.
